description: Sankey Pro Chart is a professional-grade Sankey diagram visual for Microsoft Power BI, designed to visualize flow, allocation, and relationships between categories with clarity and depth. Key Features: Flow visualization — display how values move between sources and destinations across multiple stages Interactive selection — click nodes or links to isolate and highlight connected paths; Ctrl+click for multi-select Dependency modes — trace upstream or downstream paths from any node with animated transitions Right-click filtering — native Power BI Include / Exclude context menu on nodes for report-level filtering Search & highlight — built-in search bar to locate and dim non-matching nodes instantly Flexible color control — color by source or destination; per-node and per-link custom colors; gradient links; measure-driven color support Value labels — configurable node and link value labels with display units (K/M/B), decimal places, prefix/suffix, and font controls Zoom & pan — smooth zoom and pan with fit-to-view, reset layout, and keyboard-friendly controls Node drag & drop — manually reposition nodes; layout persists across filter changes Full formatting pane — rich formatting options for nodes, links, labels, colors, and layout via the Power BI formatting pane Use cases: budget allocation, supply chain mapping, energy flow, organizational headcount movement, financial fund…
